llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets slide index 0 (first slide) and looks for 'PlaceHolder 1' which is the standard title placeholder in PPTX files.
Getter reads run.font.bold and converts to bool, correctly handling the None (inherit) case as False.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('expected_bold') without unwrapping a 'rules' key.
Expected value expected_bold=true correctly matches the instruction requirement to make the title bold.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads the updated state.

Minor concern: getter only checks the bold property of the FIRST run in the FIRST paragraph of the title. If the title contains multiple runs (e.g., mixed formatting), only the first run is verified. For a 'make bold' task, all runs should ideally be checked to confirm the entire title is bold.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider iterating over all runs in all paragraphs of the title shape to verify ALL text is bold, not just the first run. Return False if any run is not bold.
